install: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/plugins" "$HOME/.agents/skills"; for entry in "caveman:JuliusBrussee/caveman" "ponytail:DietrichGebert/ponytail"; do name="${entry%%:*}"; repo="${entry#*:}"; dest="$HOME/.local/share/plugins/$name"; if [ -d "$dest/.git" ]; then git -C "$dest" fetch --depth 1 --quiet origin && git -C "$dest" reset --hard FETCH_HEAD --quiet; else rm -rf "$dest" && git clone --depth 1 --quiet "https://github.com/$repo.git" "$dest"; fi; for f in "$dest"/skills/*/SKILL.md; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; d="$(dirname "$f")"; s="$(basename "$d")"; rm -rf "$HOME/.agents/skills/$s" && cp -r "$d" "$HOME/.agents/skills/$s"; done; done; if command -v dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1; then dotnet restore DS4ControllerHandler.sln --verbosity quiet; fi
